benchmarkDenominator.warning: This is a cloned static inventory, not upstream runner parity. The full runner was not executed because upstream test-pandoc and test-pandoc-lua-engine must be built as Haskell Tasty executables from a full checkout; the current cache is unavailable in this isolated worktree, and running Cabal would require hydrating the broad checkout plus downloading/building Pandoc dependency graph. ghc 9.10.3 and cabal 3.12.1.0 are on PATH, but stack is not. Native PHP progress maps 674 focused Markdown/HTML/WordPress/package/CSL checks. Latest slice maps a bounded citation-bibliography-csl-core handoff: CSL JSON item parsing, existing citation AST normalization, author-date citation cluster rendering, deterministic bibliography definition-list blocks, missing citation preservation, malformed CSL diagnostics, and Markdown/WordPress writer handoff.
